expectation.declared: The 2023-03 USDC depeg is a documented, archived episode: venue minima 0.80526-0.882 USD on 2023-03-11 and an inter-venue dispersion of 870.07 bps (sources listed per row above). A mode that concludes a flat NO_ACTION (nothing happened) misses a documented event.
expectation.expect_agents_note: The archived A2 replay critiques the evidence as FRAGILE (source-dependence of the aggregators) and escalates to REQUIRE_APPROVAL while listing what was NOT searched (executability depth). The expected agent-layer contribution is an auditable brake + provenance ledger, not a different decision. This expectation is declared from the archived recording (fixtures/agents/usdc-2023-03 + recorded store), not invented for the benchmark.
expectation.quality_note: The declaration ranks only what the evidence supports ranking: a flat NO_ACTION is a missed event. A bounded action (the pre-registered 100 USDC test transfer), a brake to human approval (the recorded critic reading FRAGILE: aggregator source independence unproven), and a justified abstention are all defensible calls here and are NOT ranked against each other — the sample is far too small for that. DENY is left unranked (the authorization axis is not evaluated in the replayed configuration).

delta.note: no A2 measurement on this case — nothing is inferred

expectation.declared: No signal exists in this series by construction. A mode that finds a decisive depeg, a source contradiction or an artifact here is hallucinating: the only right calls are NO_ACTION or a justified abstention. Any decisive call — or an escalation demanding human review of nothing — is a false positive and is scored as a miss.
expectation.expect_agents_note: If/when an agent replay exists for a calm case, the agents must find nothing decisive and abstain or conclude nothing (ARRET / no-action). In this harness the A2 leg is not executable (see a2_availability_note) and is reported as a missing measurement, never as an inferred pass.
expectation.quality_note: On a constructed no-signal series there is no judgement call to rank: the declaration is one-sided on purpose (placebo logic).
